title: Chunk
description: One document of the Chunk Store (collection chunks): one retrieval unit cut from the scene records of one scene set under one chunking fingerprint. Written only by the chunking step; read by the embedding step and the query-api role of the retrieval service. Carries what every retrieved source needs: asset version, scene indices, time span, entitlements, source ids and lineage.

_id.description: Data version of the chunk: hash(sorted scene record versions + fingerprint + chunk index).

scene_set_version.description: Data version of the scene set the chunk was cut from (as scene-api publishes it).

asset_version.description: Content hash of the asset version, denormalised for liveness and purge queries.

chunk_index.description: Position among the chunks of the scene set under this fingerprint.

scene_indices.description: Scenes the chunk covers, ascending; at least one.

sources.description: Source references holding the asset version, for citations.

entitlements.description: Who may see the chunk: the asset version's entitlements, sorted.

classifications.description: Distinct data classifications of the text that went in, sorted.

keyframes.description: Keyframes of the covered scenes, in stream order; their bytes are served by scene-api under the digest.

enrichments.description: The enrichment records whose text went in.

datetime.description: UTC timestamp. Stored as a BSON date; rendered as RFC 3339 in JSON samples.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the step: its hyperparameters (upstream pins included) and output-defining code.

inputs.description: Data versions read: the scene records the chunk covers.

image.description: Digest of the service image, when known.
